title: How to Create Quotation, Sales Order, and Purchase Request Without Item Code in ERP Next

posts.name: Veeramani76
posts.cooked:
Hello,

I have a requirement in ERPNext to:

  • Create Quotations, Sales Orders, and Purchase Requests based only on Item Description, without making Item Code mandatory.
  • Enter Description, Quantity, Rate, Taxes, and other fields manually.
  • HSN/SAC and other item master fields should not be mandatory.
  • Ensure that the printed PDF reports reflect the manually entered Description, Tax, and other details correctly.

I would like to know:

  1. How to customize the standard DocTypes (Quotation Item, Sales Order Item, Purchase Request Item) from start to end to achieve this.
  2. How to make Description editable per line.
  3. How to handle Taxes and Charges manually per line without an Item Code.
  4. What Role Permissions are needed in Role Permission Manager for users to create and submit these transactions.
  5. Best practices to implement this safely without affecting standard workflows and future ERPNext upgrades.
  6. Whether it’s better to use a generic ADHOC item or allow completely blank Item Code lines.
  7. Any recommended standard features** to achieve this.

Any step-by-step guidance, screenshots, or functional workflow references would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you!
